memoryHook: Kommunismus: an idea from Trier that shaped the 20th century.

quiz.prompt: Der Sozialismus was, in Marxist theory…

goodToKnow: Der Kommunismus is communism. Its founding text, the Kommunistisches Manifest (1848), was written by two Germans: Karl Marx, born in Trier in 1818, and Friedrich Engels, from Wuppertal. In the GDR, the official ideology was Sozialismus, seen as a step towards communism. After 1989, communist regimes collapsed across Eastern Europe. Today Trier has a Karl Marx museum, popular with visitors from China. Like all -ismus nouns, it's masculine.
